findings.message: Registration route reports/export/transaction-register/csv has no throttle middleware — automated signups unmitigated. Add ->middleware('throttle:5,1').
Registration route reports/transaction-register has no throttle middleware — automated signups unmitigated. Add ->middleware('throttle:5,1').
Email verification route 'verification.notice' (verify-email) is missing 'signed' middleware — URL parameters can be tampered with.
APP_ENV is 'local' — leaks development-mode behavior in production.
SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE is false — sessions cookies will be sent over HTTP and can be hijacked on shared networks.
shell-quote 1.8.4 - 1.10.0 — shell-quote: `quote()` command injection via a line terminator in a token after a `{ comment }` token
app.url is not set or points to localhost — host header injection can redirect users, set cookies, generate signed URLs, and poison password reset emails.
allow_url_fopen is on — file functions can be tricked into reading remote URLs, enabling SSRF and credential exfiltration via file:// or http:// wrappers.
expose_php is on — server response headers (X-Powered-By) leak the PHP version, helping attackers fingerprint your stack.
API route api/widget-preferences has no HTTPS-enforcing middleware and APP_URL is http://localhost. Add 'force.https' middleware or set APP_URL to https://.
API route api/widget-preferences/hidden-widgets has no HTTPS-enforcing middleware and APP_URL is http://localhost. Add 'force.https' middleware or set APP_URL to https://.
API route api/widget-preferences/reset has no HTTPS-enforcing middleware and APP_URL is http://localhost. Add 'force.https' middleware or set APP_URL to https://.
